FCF margin uses OCF $89,675M minus gross PP&E capex $30,712M = 44.3% of FY26 revenue $133,188M (Micron's 'adjusted FCF' net of government incentives/proceeds = 46.8%; net capex 20.5%). capex_pct uses gross capex 23.1%. Net cash = cash 38,364 + ST inv 5,070 + LT marketable inv 30,019 - debt 5,179 at 2026-09-03. Margins are peak-cycle (memory is a mean-reverting commodity). Revenue model classed commodity (DRAM/HBM/NAND) despite multi-year Strategic Customer Agreements. No dated 2026 red flags found. EV/NTM sales derived from SA forward P/S (approximate).
